note: v56.97 — Codex review fixes: one close basis for every market input, missing never read as a verdict, observation apart from interpretation, date-aligned charts; architecture contract updated for the rebuilt screens; portfolio PIN and schedule status (P1399-P1401).

p.title: Portfolio PIN accepts the vault contract (4-20 characters); schedule separates time passed from result received
p.symptom: Codex review: the vault setup accepts a 4-20 character PIN, but the portfolio unlock field allowed 4 digits only (maxlength=4, numeric pattern, /^\d{4,}$/), locking out 6-digit or alphanumeric PINs. The briefing schedule marked an event '발표됨' once its clock time passed, and the heading said '이번 주' for a next-7-days window.
p.root_cause: Two PIN inputs were written with different contracts; the schedule derived status from the clock alone.
p.fix: index.html pf-pin-input minlength 4 / maxlength 20 without the numeric pattern; aio-workspace.js unlockPortfolio checks length 4-20. schedule.js status = received (EPS actual in hand) / time-passed / upcoming; the briefing shows '발표됨' only for received and '예정 시각 지남' otherwise; heading '앞으로 7일 일정'.
p.violated_rule: One contract per secret input; a status names what was observed.
p.prevention: ci-portfolio-vault-e2e keeps the 4-digit path; the input attributes and schedule status are asserted by inspection in this batch.
p.verification: Local browser briefing schedule shows future rows without 발표됨; PIN field accepts 20 characters.

changelog: **PIN·일정 (P1401):** 포트폴리오 PIN 입력을 Vault 설정과 같은 4~20자로 맞추고, 일정은 예정 시각 경과와 결과 수신을 구분.
